Thanks again for the discovery earlier today. Short recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

- Current constraints: Horizon devs want VPC private deployment or dedicated capacity; sample dataset (anonymized) available next week.
- Success metric: end-to-end pilot with 50k tokens/day and SLA for 99th percentile response time tracked in Redwood Console.

Next steps we agreed on
1) Exec alignment (20 min) — intro between your VP/Product or CTO + our Head of Solutions to unblock procurement/infra decisions.
2) Technical deep dive (60 min) — engineering-to-engineering to scope integration and timelines.
3) Pilot scope doc review — attached a short draft (pilot-scope-draft-v1.pdf).

Proposed windows for VP/CTO alignment (PT):
- Tue 10 May, 09:30–09:50 PT
- Tue 10 May, 11:00–11:20 PT
- Wed 11 May, 08:30–08:50 PT

If none of those work, send 2 slots that do and we’ll lock it. Attendees we recommend: your CTO (or VP Eng), Jared (prod), our VP Sales (Ben) and Karthik (solutions).

I’ve attached the one-page pilot scope for reference. Happy to iterate before the call.

Best,
